note: Tuned model constants. Values here are the live model. The weekly improvement loop (improve/improve.py) proposes changes, tests them, and edits this file only when a change passes the gate; every edit is logged in ledger/changelog.md and ledger/experiments.jsonl. Layer says where a value is used: builder = pipeline/build_db.py (and backtest/backtest_core.py), engine = engine/engine.js. Eval says how a change is tested: backtest = multi-season replay with known availability; live = replay of archived weekly inputs (needs enough graded weeks).

prior_games.desc: Games of weight behind last season's usage share

prior_moved.desc: Same, for a player who changed teams

vet_prior.desc: Multiplier on prior weight and past-season efficiency for veterans (RB 28+, WR/TE 30+, QB 35+)

team_prior.desc: Games of league-average volume behind each team's pool size

decay.desc: Per-week weight decay in this season's share fit

blend2.desc: Weight of the season before last in the usage prior when last season is a full sample

w1.desc: Weight of last season's opportunities in efficiency

w2.desc: Weight of the season before last in efficiency

low_target.desc: Scale on opportunities needed before efficiency shrinks to the full-league rate instead of the low-volume rate

rookie_prior.desc: Weight on the rookie model's share and efficiency prior for drafted rookies with no NFL history (data/rookie/predictions.csv); 0 = none

K_cpa.desc: Shrinkage for QB carries per attempt

K_fl.desc: Shrinkage for fumbles lost per opportunity

env_shrink.desc: Shrink on game environment for weeks without a Vegas line (fixed: the replays only see real lines)

damp.desc: Share of a short-term absentee's work that goes to depth players we don't model

ret_disc.desc: Share weight in a player's first game back

env_scale.desc: Scale on all game-environment (Vegas line) elasticities

expertWeight.desc: Default weight on FantasyPros rest-of-season consensus

weeklyExpert.desc: Default weight on FantasyPros weekly ranks, current week only
